checks: An unsaved native editor change updates the bank and retained record; the actual stock COKI validator accepts the refreshed header.
Stale project generation, invalid COKI header and out-of-range slots refuse before retained-record writes.
Actual stock memcpy plus exact producer/consumer continuations carry step records through paste, undo-paste and the clear-undo snapshot, preserving the source pattern.
Unknown and previous-generation clipboard sources produce absent/disabled steps, not stale destination or foreign-project settings.
A new/failed project capture revokes mirror ownership; a successful matching retained-image encode reestablishes it.
The editor retains its original interrupt mask/flags around notification, bank commit and retained-image synchronization.
limits: PC-only. No hardware timing, cache coherence, automatic power-fail dispatch or complete RAM ownership certification.
Clipboard and undo extension records are generation-scoped; unknown/stale/cross-project kit sources restore absent disabled steps.
Pattern clear follows stock MIDI-setting semantics: it clears trigs while retaining arp settings.
Only the verified native pattern clipboard handlers and native incremental retained-kit serializer are adapted; other copy/reset/bypass families remain unproven.
Isolated native-header, project and exact-callsite fixtures; actual panel copy/undo and write/reboot chains are separate tests.
